cases.name: Bend a sine
cases.title: Bend a sine — Keep ratio and index direct while folding the changing-source choices
cases.message: ratio and index remain direct while source phase and changing-index choices share a silent door
cases.steps: Inside section.controls leave the intact .control for #bend-ratio first and #bend-index second. After these two add closed details#bend-source-choices. Move the intact .control blocks for #bend-phase (including .control-help), #bend-mode and #bend-moment into it, in that order. Keep every label associated and all values/options/disabled semantics unchanged. Preserve703's slower ratios if already shipped. Do not reparent plots, sound or repeat-marker controls.
cases.palette: paper #ede6d8, ink #202d39, plot #13212b, cyan #64d9d0, orange #efa562; existing Georgia/system16
copy: This shifts the bending sine, not its frequency. The carrier still starts at zero phase.
